messages:
nina_k: Proposal: shrink console analytics row payloads. Keep hot indexed fields in events_v2, move blobby freeform payloads to compressed storage (blobs table or object store). Expected win: ~35-45% storage reduction and lower p99 for dashboard tiles. Feedback?

maria_w: Concern: we must avoid breaking existing dashboard aggregations and ad-hoc SQL used by ops. How do we surface staleness? :thinking_face:

nina_k: Plan: dual-write phase + read-adapter. Read-adapter resolves most queries from events_v2; falls back to decompress blobs when needed. Also async recompute pipeline warms derived tiles; Console displays a "stale" badge per tile until recompute finishes.

sanjay_p: Add an opt-in header for tenants: `X-Telemetry-Store: v2-beta` so we can test without SDK changes. For GROUP BY heavy queries, provide a lateral helper or precomputed aggregates. Also define a compatibility mode that routes certain queries to legacy store.

ella: Backfill will alter route-level aggregates and may evict KV caches. Need cost and slot-hour estimates and a plan to protect cache hit rates during migration.

ryan_ops: Infra can run backfills with rate limiting and pause/resume. We'll gate by feature flag per-tenant `telemetry_storage.v2`. Suggest backfill tooling: `tooling/backfill_telemetry --tenant=foo --from=2025-03-01 --to=2025-03-02 --rate=150/s`.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy telem-read-adapter v2 -> 5% tenants at 2025-03-04T02:00Z :rocket:

maria_w: Console UX: expose migration dashboard per-tenant with progress, affected tiles list, pause/resume, and estimated recompute time per tile. That helps CS and PMs.

sanjay_p: Define SLO gates: if p99 for dashboard queries increases >20% or error rate increases >1% after enabling, auto-pause migration for that tenant and page #eng-oncall. Fallback: if read-adapter misses >5% of required attrs for an aggregator, route that request to legacy storage.

nina_k: Canary rollout: 5% tenants for 48h (monitor p50/p95/p99, cost delta, backfill lag), then 25% for 24h, then region-staggered ramp. Add prechecks: no active long-running analytics jobs for a tenant in the backfill window.

ella: Example lateral aggregation rewrite to avoid blob scans: `SELECT r.route_id, sum((jsonb_extract_path_text(decompress(r.attrs_compressed),'duration'))::int) total_ms FROM events_v2 r GROUP BY r.route_id;`. Will add more examples to the query guide.

ryan_ops: We'll expose a maintenance flag `tenant_maintenance=true` to reduce load during heavy backfills; Console will show it. Also will cap concurrent backfill jobs per region.

maria_w: Please add these steps and abort conditions to the migration runbook and include a Console snippet so customers can self-serve pause.

nina_k: I'll open the runbook PR and implement the Console migration endpoints: `GET /v1/migration/{tenant}` and `POST /v1/migration/{tenant}/pause`. Tagging follow-ups: @sanjay_p for SLOs, @ryan_ops for infra, @ella for query rewrites. Thanks everyone.
